title: Flag multiresolutions: T1, paraproducts and commutators
summary: We develop a rich theory of dyadic-probabilistic multiresolution methods in the context of flag type singular integrals. We apply these methods to prove a full $T1$ theorem, even a representation theorem, for bi-parameter flag singular integrals. This is the first time a complete $T1$ theorem appears in a multi-parameter setting with an entangled nature; even the related recent advances with Zygmund dilations have been in the cancellative $T1 = 0$ or convolution situations.
